title: Community awareness, knowledge, attitudes, preventive behaviors, and intended responses to Ebola virus disease in Burao, Somaliland: implications for outbreak preparedness.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Understanding public awareness and responses to Ebola virus disease (EVD) may inform risk communication in settings without documented transmission. We assessed prior awareness among adults in Burao, Somaliland, and knowledge, attitudes, current behaviors, and hypothetical outbreak responses among those who had previously heard of EVD. METHODS: A community-based cross-sectional survey was conducted from 2 June to 21 July 2026 among adults aged 18 years or older who had lived in Burao for at least 6 months. Of 788 consenting adults, all contributed to the awareness and perception analyses; 387 who had previously heard of EVD completed detailed modules. Scores were analyzed continuously using multivariable linear regression and sensitivity analyses using interviewer-clustered standard errors and fractional logistic models. No design weights or verified sampling primary sampling unit identifiers were available. RESULTS: Of 788 consenting adults, 387 (49.1%) had previously heard of EVD. Only this previously aware subgroup (n = 387) completed the knowledge, attitude, current-behavior, and intended-response modules. Their mean knowledge, favorable-attitude, and intended-response scores were 60.6% (SD 24.1), 67.0% (SD 14.0), and 73.3% (SD 19.6), respectively. Post-secondary education was associated with prior awareness (adjusted prevalence ratio 1.87, 95% CI 1.52-2.31). Recent EVD information and formal EVD education were associated with higher knowledge scores. Knowledge was positively associated with the favorable-attitude score, and both were associated with intended-response scores; these primary patterns persisted in interviewer-clustered and bounded-outcome sensitivity analyses. Of all 788 consenting adults, 602 (76.4%) supported additional public EVD education. CONCLUSIONS: Approximately half of respondents had previously heard of EVD. Knowledge, attitude, current-behavior, and intended-response estimates apply only to those with prior awareness and must not be interpreted as community-wide measures or verified outbreak readiness. Findings identify communication priorities but do not establish causal relationships or predict behavior during an outbreak.

source_records.title: Virus
source_records.abstract: A critical, annotated version of Narlikar’s iconic novel about a cybervirus attack by an advanced alien species—with updated text and added material. A year before Robin Cook’s Invasion (1997)—in which an alien force activates a latent biological virus in humans—and almost a decade before Liu Cixin’s The Remembrance of Earth’s Past trilogy (2008–2010)—in which humanity’s scientific progress is curtailed by an alien supercomputer’s “sophon-lock”—Jayant Vishnu Narlikar’s Virus (1996) painted a similar scenario. In his novel, a cybervirus broadcast by an advanced, extraterrestrial species invades Earth and freezes its digital infrastructure: a prelude to an alien invasion. The novel, first published in Marathi, recounts how vast radio arrays on Earth intercept a seemingly innocuous message from an unknown planet orbiting Barnard’s Star. The radio signal, sent six years prior, coalesces into a cybervirus that has the potential to cause a complete digital meltdown and lead humanity into an age of chaos—an alien first strike to prevent humanity from evolving further. This book—a critical, annotated version of Virus, edited and revised by Sami Ahmad Khan—reissues Narlikar’s iconic novel with updated text and added dimensions. It includes detailed annotations that locate the technology of the text along the axis of contemporary scientific thought, as well as critical essays that focus on the literary, political, and sociocultural dimensions of the novel; essays on Narlikar’s role in India’s science and science fiction; an exclusive conversation with the author; bibliographical information on his works; and a bonus short story. Contributions by Sami Ahmad Khan, Nilam Ingole, Priteegandha Naik, Jayant V. Narlikar, and Dibyadyuti Roy.

source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Understanding public awareness and responses to Ebola virus disease (EVD) may inform risk communication in settings without documented transmission. We assessed prior awareness among adults in Burao, Somaliland, and knowledge, attitudes, current behaviors, and hypothetical outbreak responses among those who had previously heard of EVD. METHODS: A community-based cross-sectional survey was conducted from 2 June to 21 July 2026 among adults aged 18 years or older who had lived in Burao for at least 6 months. Of 788 consenting adults, all contributed to the awareness and perception analyses; 387 who had previously heard of EVD completed detailed modules. Scores were analyzed continuously using multivariable linear regression and sensitivity analyses using interviewer-clustered standard errors and fractional logistic models. No design weights or verified sampling primary sampling unit identifiers were available. RESULTS: Of 788 consenting adults, 387 (49.1%) had previously heard of EVD. Only this previously aware subgroup (n = 387) completed the knowledge, attitude, current-behavior, and intended-response modules. Their mean knowledge, favorable-attitude, and intended-response scores were 60.6% (SD 24.1), 67.0% (SD 14.0), and 73.3% (SD 19.6), respectively. Post-secondary education was associated with prior awareness (adjusted prevalence ratio 1.87, 95% CI 1.52-2.31). Recent EVD information and formal EVD education were associated with higher knowledge scores. Knowledge was positively associated with the favorable-attitude score, and both were associated with intended-response scores; these primary patterns persisted in interviewer-clustered and bounded-outcome sensitivity analyses. Of all 788 consenting adults, 602 (76.4%) supported additional public EVD education. CONCLUSIONS: Approximately half of respondents had previously heard of EVD. Knowledge, attitude, current-behavior, and intended-response estimates apply only to those with prior awareness and must not be interpreted as community-wide measures or verified outbreak readiness. Findings identify communication priorities but do not establish causal relationships or predict behavior during an outbreak.

title: Ebola Virus Transmission and Prevention in Healthcare Settings: A Focused Review for Healthcare Professionals
abstract: This focused review synthesizes current evidence on Ebola virus disease (EVD) transmission and infection prevention and control (IPC) measures within healthcare settings. Given its high mortality rate, potential for rapid spread, and the vulnerability of healthcare workers (HCWs), this review aims to clarify transmission pathways, highlight essential diagnostic and protective strategies, and integrate lessons from recent outbreaks, particularly the 2026 Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) epidemic. Evidence confirms that EVD transmission in healthcare facilities is driven primarily by direct contact with infected bodily fluids, with percutaneous injuries posing the highest risk. Viral persistence in semen, ocular fluid, and breast milk underscores ongoing transmission potential even after recovery. Updated WHO and CDC guidance emphasize rigorous personal protective equipment (PPE) use, safe injection practices, environmental decontamination, and strict isolation. The 2026 BDBV outbreak revealed new IPC challenges: delayed case detection due to nonspecific early symptoms, inadequate triage systems, limited diagnostic capacity for BDBV, and operational barriers, including insecurity and disrupted referral pathways. These gaps highlight the need for strengthened surveillance, decentralized testing, and continuous training of healthcare workers. EVD prevention in healthcare settings requires a multilayered IPC approach grounded in early identification, strict isolation, meticulous PPE use, safe clinical practices, and robust environmental management. Training, psychological support, and continuous monitoring of HCWs are essential for sustaining compliance. Preparedness must evolve through improved diagnostics, enhanced triage systems, and institutional commitment to IPC excellence. This review consolidates current evidence to support safer healthcare environments and reduce nosocomial transmission risks.

title_zh: 埃博拉病毒 传播 和医疗保健环境中的预防:针对医疗保健专业人员的重点审查
source_body_en: This focused review synthesizes current evidence on Ebola virus disease (EVD) transmission and infection prevention and control (IPC) measures within healthcare settings. Given its high mortality rate, potential for rapid spread, and the vulnerability of healthcare workers (HCWs), this review aims to clarify transmission pathways, highlight essential diagnostic and protective strategies, and integrate lessons from recent outbreaks, particularly the 2026 Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) epidemic. Evidence confirms that EVD transmission in healthcare facilities is driven primarily by direct contact with infected bodily fluids, with percutaneous injuries posing the highest risk. Viral persistence in semen, ocular fluid, and breast milk underscores ongoing transmission potential even after recovery. Updated WHO and CDC guidance emphasize rigorous personal protective equipment (PPE) use, safe injection practices, environmental decontamination, and strict isolation. The 2026 BDBV outbreak revealed new IPC challenges: delayed case detection due to nonspecific early symptoms, inadequate triage systems, limited diagnostic capacity for BDBV, and operational barriers, including insecurity and disrupted referral pathways. These gaps highlight the need for strengthened surveillance, decentralized testing, and continuous training of healthcare workers. EVD prevention in healthcare settings requires a multilayered IPC approach grounded in early identification, strict isolation, meticulous PPE use, safe clinical practices, and robust environmental management. Training, psychological support, and continuous monitoring of HCWs are essential for sustaining compliance. Preparedness must evolve through improved diagnostics, enhanced triage systems, and institutional commitment to IPC excellence. This review consolidates current evidence to support safer healthcare environments and reduce nosocomial transmission risks.

title: Early epidemiological and spatial assessment of the Bundibugyo virus outbreak 2026.
abstract: A Bundibugyo virus outbreak was first reported on May 15th, 2026 in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with multiple cases reported across health zones during the early phase of the outbreak and suggestions of circulation weeks prior to detection. We pair highly resolved case and testing records with human mobility data to investigate the early outbreak dynamics of Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD). We show that human movement was a principle driver of early spatial expansion between May 10th and June 1st when the number of health zones and health areas reporting positive cases increased by 12 and 49, respectively. The early doubling time was estimated at ~10 days. Our work shows the rapid spatial expansion and growth of BVD with implications for intervention strategies.

title_zh: 本迪布焦病毒 暴发 2026 的早期流行病学和空间评估。
source_body_en: A Bundibugyo virus outbreak was first reported on May 15th, 2026 in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with multiple cases reported across health zones during the early phase of the outbreak and suggestions of circulation weeks prior to detection. We pair highly resolved case and testing records with human mobility data to investigate the early outbreak dynamics of Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD). We show that human movement was a principle driver of early spatial expansion between May 10th and June 1st when the number of health zones and health areas reporting positive cases increased by 12 and 49, respectively. The early doubling time was estimated at ~10 days. Our work shows the rapid spatial expansion and growth of BVD with implications for intervention strategies.

title: Construction of minigenomic replicon and infectious virus-like particle systems for Ebola virus with epitope-tagged L polymerase.
abstract: Ebola virus (EBOV) L protein is the viral RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRp) and a key antiviral target. Functional dissection of L during infection is hampered by scarce specific anti-L antibodies and mandatory BSL-4 containment for live EBOV. Here, we established two BSL-2 reverse genetic systems harboring tagged L protein to address these obstacles. First, we generated stable EBOV minigenomic replicon cells constitutively expressing NP, VP30, VP35 and TagL, supporting sustained viral minigenome replication. Second, we developed an infectious virus-like particle (iVLP) system in which an EBOV subgenome encoding GP, VP40 and VP24 replicates robustly in optimized TagL-expressing helper cells to generate fully infectious iVLPs, recapitulating the entire EBOV life cycle. Proteomic analysis of intact iVLPs and delipidated ribonucleoprotein (RNP) complexes uncovered a previously unrecognized association between EBOV RNP and cytoskeletal proteins. Pharmacological disruption of microtubules enhanced EBOV replication/transcription and virion production, providing new insights into virus-host interactions during EBOV infection. Collectively, these optimized TagL-integrated reverse genetics tools provide tractable BSL-2 tools to study EBOV L-RNP biology during the full viral life cycle.

title: Reverse Transcription Loop-Mediated Isothermal Amplification Combined with Lateral Flow Assay (RT-LAMP-LFA) for Rapid Detection of the 2026 Bundibugyo Virus (BDBV) Outbreak Strain
abstract: Abstract Making accurate diagnosis is a critical first step in patient management and control for emerging and re-emerging disease outbreaks. Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) is a filovirus that causes Ebola disease, and the 2026 outbreak highlights the need for rapid diagnostic approaches that can be deployed in settings with limited laboratory infrastructure. Here, we developed a reverse transcription loop-mediated isothermal amplification–lateral flow assay (RT-LAMP-LFA) for rapid detection of the 2026 BDBV outbreak strain. LAMP primers were designed based on the genome sequence of the 2026 outbreak strain, and the conservation of the primer binding sites among all available 2026 outbreak genomes was confirmed in silico. LAMP primers were evaluated for analytical specificity and sensitivity using in vitro-transcribed RNA (ivtRNA) from BDBV and other filoviruses, as well as RNA derived from arboviruses and mammalian cells. Amplification products were detected using a Chromatography-Printed Array Strip (C-PAS) lateral flow platform. The newly designed primers specifically detected the presence of BDBV RNA without nonspecific amplification of the other viral or cellular RNA samples tested. Consistent amplification was observed down to 10 3 copies per reaction. In addition, BDBV viral RNA was successfully amplified, and the amplification products were detected using C-PAS, with the total workflow being completed within 25 min. These findings demonstrate the analytical specificity and sensitivity of the developed RT-LAMP-LFA assay and its compatibility with rapid visual lateral flow detection, supporting its potential application as a point-of-care approach for BDBV detection. Importance Bundibugyo virus causes a form of Ebola disease for which rapid and reliable diagnostic testing is essential to support outbreak response. However, molecular tests may require specialized equipment and laboratory infrastructure, limiting access to testing in remote or resource-limited settings. In this study, we developed a rapid molecular assay targeting the 2026 outbreak strain of Bundibugyo virus. The assay detected viral RNA at concentrations as low as 10 3 copies per reaction, showed no nonspecific amplification with the other viral and cellular RNA samples tested, and produced results using a visual detection platform within approximately 25 minutes, excluding sample preparation. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of a rapid and simplified approach for Bundibugyo virus detection. Further evaluation using clinical specimens and under field conditions is needed to establish its diagnostic performance and practical applicability.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在开发一种针对 2026 本迪布焦病毒 (BDBV) 暴发 毒株的快速诊断方法,因为准确的 诊断 对于管理新出现的疾病 暴发 至关重要。这一背景凸显了对 BDBV 进行快速、可靠的诊断测试的重要性,BDBV 会导致一种埃博拉疾病。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究针对 2026 BDBV 暴发 菌株开发了一种逆转录环介导的等温扩增-侧流测定 (RT-LAMP-LFA)。该测定使用来自 BDBV 和其他丝状病毒的体外转录 RNA,以及来自虫媒病毒和哺乳动物细胞的 RNA 进行评估。
analysis_zh.methods: RT-LAMP-LFA 测定是使用基于 2026 BDBV 暴发 菌株的 基因组 序列设计的 LAMP 引物开发的。使用色谱印刷阵列条 (C-PAS) 侧流平台检测扩增产物。
analysis_zh.main_results: LAMP 引物特异性检测 BDBV RNA,无需对其他病毒或细胞 RNA 样本进行非特异性扩增。每个反应观察到一致的扩增低至 10^3 个拷贝,并且使用视觉检测在 25 分钟内完成整个工作流程。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果证明了 RT-LAMP-LFA 检测的分析特异性和敏感性,支持其作为 BDBV 即时诊断工具的潜力。该研究引入了一种简化且快速的方法来检测 2026 暴发 菌株。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: RT-LAMP-LFA 测定可以为资源有限环境中 BDBV 快速诊断工具的开发提供信息,从而改善 暴发 反应和患者管理。

title: Doxycycline and Nitazoxanide as a Candidate Immunomodulatory Combination for the Early Management of Ebola Disease Caused by Bundibugyo Virus
abstract: As of 11 November 2026, Bundibugyo virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo had produced 11,114 confirmed cases and 5,433 deaths, and in the latest WHO interval close to two of every three deaths were in communities, not treatment centres, especially among young children. No vaccine or treatment is approved for this species, and the agents in trials are monoclonal antibodies and direct-acting antivirals. In 2021, I proposed reclassifying COVID-19, Ebola virus disease and Nipah virus infection as a novel acute immune dysrhythmia syndrome. Read through it, the pathology described in Bundibugyo-infected macaques points to two arms: fatal animals showed myeloid hyperinflammation with raised interleukin-6 and myeloperoxidase, survivors showed transcripts consistent with an intact T cell response. Basing on that convergence I propose doxycycline and nitazoxanide as an early immunomodulatory combination, each on a different arm. Doxycycline inhibits matrix metalloproteinases at exposures achievable in man. Nitazoxanide amplifies RNA sensing and interferon signalling; its inhibition of Zaire ebolavirus in cell culture depends on RIG-I and PKR. However, none of this establishes efficacy in this disease. What it offers is a mechanism worth testing in two licensed, oral, inexpensive drugs on the shelf, the host-directed concentration unmeasured. I therefore ask for species-specific work to begin soonest: activity in relevant cells and in the macaque model, the unbound concentration-response relationship, and a two-by-two factorial evaluation, preclinical and clinical, powered for the interaction. For the patient who cannot reach a participating unit, I also call for monitored emergency use under the WHO framework, with every outcome recorded and reported. I strongly suggest that the search for safe immunomodulators is the one most likely to end in a drug available on the day it is needed.

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the need for effective treatments for Bundibugyo virus disease, which has caused significant morbidity and mortality in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The research highlights the lack of approved vaccines or treatments and proposes doxycycline and nitazoxanide as a potential immunomodulatory combination. Based on observations from infected macaques, the study identifies two distinct pathological arms: fatal cases show myeloid hyperinflammation with elevated interleukin-6 and myeloperoxidase, while survivors exhibit intact T cell responses. However, the study does not provide direct evidence of their effectiveness in humans and calls for further research, including species-specific testing and a factorial evaluation. The findings are of scientific and public health significance as they offer a potential therapeutic approach for a disease with limited treatment options.

abstract_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月 11 日,刚果民主共和国的本迪布焦病毒病已产生 11,114 例确诊病例和 5,433 例死亡,在世界卫生组织的最新间隔中,近三分之二的死亡发生在社区,而不是 治疗 中心,尤其是幼儿。疫苗 或 治疗 尚未获批用于该物种,试验中的药物为单克隆抗体和直接作用的 抗病毒药物。2021年,我提议将COVID-19、埃博拉病毒病和尼帕病毒感染重新分类为一种新型急性免疫节律紊乱综合征。读完它,Bundibugyo 感染的猕猴中描述的病理学指向两个方面:致命的动物表现出骨髓过度炎症,白细胞介素 6 和髓过氧化物酶升高,幸存者表现出与完整 T 细胞反应一致的转录本。基于这种趋同,我建议将多西环素和硝唑尼特作为早期免疫调节组合,分别使用不同的手臂。多西环素在人体可达到的暴露量下抑制基质金属蛋白酶。Nitazoxanide 增强 RNA 传感和干扰素信号传导;它在细胞培养中对扎伊尔埃博拉病毒的抑制作用依赖于 RIG-I 和 PKR。然而,这些都没有证实对这种疾病的疗效。它提供的是一种值得在货架上的两种获得许可的口服廉价药物中进行测试的机制,宿主 定向浓度未测量。因此,我要求尽快开始针对物种的工作:相关细胞和猕猴模型中的活性、未结合的浓度-反应关系,以及为相互作用提供动力的临床前和临床的二乘二析因评估。对于无法到达参与单位的患者,我还呼吁在世界卫生组织框架下进行监测紧急使用,记录和报告每一个结果。我强烈建议,寻找安全的免疫调节剂是最有可能在需要时获得可用药物的方法。

title: Marked Geographic Heterogeneity in Ebola Virus Disease Case Fatality During the 17th Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 2026: a Health Zone Level Funnel Plot Analysis
abstract: Abstract Background The Ebola case fatality ratio (CFR) classically varies by geographic and operational context, but this heterogeneity has rarely been formally quantified sub-nationally in real time during an active outbreak. Methods From 142 situation reports (SitReps) (May 18 to October 3, 2026), we extracted confirmed cases/deaths for 64 health zones, calculated CFR with 95% Wilson confidence intervals, tested heterogeneity by chi-square, and visualised it by Spiegelhalter funnel plot, excluding a block of 493 unallocated Ituri deaths from zone/province analyses ; sensitivity analyses tested four alternative ways of handling these deaths. Results Zone-summed CFR ranged from 33.3% (South Kivu) to 58.5% (North Kivu, 95% CI 56.1–60.8), via 38.3% in Ituri (95% CI 37.1–39.5); heterogeneity was highly significant (x 2 = 227.1, df = 6, p < 0.001) and persisted within Ituri (13 zones, x 2 = 193.5, df = 12, p < 0.001). The funnel plot flagged five zones above the 99.8% control limit (Komanda and Nia-Nia in Ituri; Beni, Butembo and Katwa in North Kivu) and five Ituri zones below it. The Ituri–North Kivu gap narrowed from ~ 29 points (late August) to 20.2 points (October 3), a real but modest convergence driven by North Kivu's decline. When the 493 unallocated deaths were added to Ituri, the gap on October 3 was 12.6 points, and the convergence remained driven by North Kivu. Conclusions Case fatality shows robust, persisting geographic heterogeneity at two scales, with a real but limited inter-provincial convergence since September, warranting targeted investigation of treatment-capacity and care-seeking determinants.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to quantify geographic heterogeneity in Ebola virus disease case fatality ratio (CFR) during the 17th outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, highlighting the need to understand how CFR varies across health zones in real time.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A funnel plot analysis was conducted using 142 situation reports (SitReps) from May 18 to October 3, 2026, covering 64 health zones. The study excluded 493 unallocated Ituri deaths from zone/province analyses and included sensitivity analyses to test alternative handling of these deaths.
analysis.methods: Confirmed cases and deaths were extracted from SitReps, CFR was calculated with 95% Wilson confidence intervals, and heterogeneity was tested using chi-square analysis. The Spiegelhalter funnel plot was used to visualize the results, with sensitivity analyses exploring different approaches to handling unallocated deaths.
analysis.main_results: Zone-summed CFR ranged from 33.3% (South Kivu) to 58.5% (North Kivu, 95% CI 56.1–60.8), with Ituri at 38.3% (95% CI 37.1–39.5). Heterogeneity was highly significant (χ2 = 227.1, df = 6, p < 0.001) and persisted within Ituri (13 zones, χ2 = 193.5, df = 12, p < 0.001).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as showing robust geographic heterogeneity in CFR at two scales, with a real but limited inter-provincial convergence since September, suggesting the need for targeted investigation of treatment-capacity and care-seeking determinants.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform targeted surveillance and intervention strategies by highlighting persistent geographic differences in CFR, which may guide resource allocation and improve understanding of factors influencing disease outcomes.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study excluded 493 unallocated Ituri deaths from zone/province analyses and tested alternative handling methods, which may affect the interpretation of CFR. The evidence is moderate due to these limitations and the reliance on real-time SitReps.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed geographic heterogeneity in Ebola virus disease case fatality ratio (CFR) during the 17th outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo using a funnel plot approach. It found significant variation in CFR across health zones, with North Kivu having the highest CFR at 58.5% and South Kivu the lowest at 33.3%. The analysis excluded 493 unallocated Ituri deaths and included sensitivity analyses to assess their impact. The findings suggest persistent geographic differences in CFR, which may be influenced by treatment capacity and care-seeking behaviors, warranting targeted investigations. The study's evidence is moderate due to the exclusion of unallocated deaths and reliance on real-time data. The results have implications for public health strategies, emphasizing the need for localized surveillance and intervention efforts.

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 埃博拉病死率 (CFR) 通常会因地理和操作环境而异,但在 暴发 活跃期间,这种异质性很少在全国范围内实时正式量化。方法 从 142 份情况报告 (SitReps)(2026 年 5 月 18 日至 10 月 3 日)中,我们提取了 64 个卫生区的确诊病例/死亡病例,使用 95% Wilson 置信区间计算 CFR,通过卡方检验异质性,并通过 Spiegelhalter 漏斗图将其可视化,排除区域/省分析中 493 例未分配的伊图里死亡病例;敏感性分析测试了处理这些死亡的四种替代方法。结果 区域总 CFR 范围为 33.3%(南基伍)至 58.5%(北基伍,95% CI 56.1–60.8),伊图里为 38.3%(95% CI 37.1–39.5);异质性非常显着(x 2 = 227.1,df = 6,p < 0.001),并且在伊图里持续存在(13 个区域,x 2 = 193.5,df = 12,p < 0.001)。漏斗图标记了高于 99.8% 控制限值的 5 个区域(伊图里的 Komanda 和 Nia-Nia;北基伍省的 Beni、Butembo 和 Katwa)以及低于 99.8% 控制限值的 5 个伊图里区域。伊图里与北基伍的差距从约 29 点(8 月下旬)缩小到 20.2 点(10 月 3 日),这是由于北基伍的下降所推动的真正但适度的趋同。当伊图里新增 493 例未分配死亡病例时,10 月 3 日的差距为 12.6 个百分点,趋同仍然是由北基伍省推动的。结论 病例死亡率在两个尺度上显示出强烈、持续的地理异质性,自 9 月份以来,省际间的趋同确实但有限,需要对 治疗 能力和就医决定因素进行有针对性的调查。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在量化刚果民主共和国第 17 届 埃博拉病毒病 病死率 (CFR) 的地理异质性,强调需要实时了解不同卫生区域的 CFR 变化。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用2026年5月18日至10月3日的142份情况报告(SitReps)进行漏斗图分析,覆盖64个卫生区。该研究从地区/省份分析中排除了 493 例未分配的伊图里死亡病例,并进行了敏感性分析,以测试对这些死亡病例的替代处理方式。
analysis_zh.methods: 从 SitReps 中提取确诊病例和死亡病例,使用 95% Wilson 置信区间计算 CFR,并使用卡方分析测试异质性。Spiegelhalter 漏斗图用于可视化结果,敏感性分析探索处理未分配死亡的不同方法。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为在两个尺度上显示了 CFR 的强烈地理异质性,自 9 月份以来确实存在但有限的省际趋同,这表明需要对 治疗 能力和寻求护理的决定因素进行有针对性的调查。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果通过强调病死率持续存在的地理差异,为有针对性的 监测 和干预策略提供信息,这可以指导资源分配并提高对影响疾病结果的因素的理解。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究从区域/省份分析中排除了 493 例未分配的伊图里死亡病例,并测试了替代处理方法,这可能会影响 CFR 的解释。由于这些限制以及对实时 SitReps 的依赖,证据是中等的。

title: Situation Analysis of the 17th Ebola Disease Outbreak Caused by Bundibugyo Virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: Feasibility and Acceptability of a Ring-Based Infection-Prevention and -Control Approach
abstract: Background: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has extensive experience responding to Ebola disease outbreaks; however, the emergence of Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) presents distinct operational challenges because its epidemiological evidence base and the available medical countermeasures are more limited than those for Zaire ebolavirus. The 2026 outbreak has been characterized by substantial transmission in Ituri Province, with reported activity in additional provinces. Operational challenges include incomplete contact follow-up, community deaths, health-system constraints, population mobility, insecurity and gaps in infection prevention and control (IPC). These challenges highlight the need for an adaptable framework that links case investigation, surveillance, IPC and community engagement. Objective: To describe the epidemiological and operational situation of the 2026 BDBV outbreak and develop a conceptual ring-oriented surveillance and IPC framework for organizing outbreak-response activities in Ituri Province, informed by evidence from previous Ebola outbreaks. Methods: A secondary descriptive situation analysis was undertaken using the outbreak situation report for the reporting period ending 11 August 2026, supplemented by a targeted narrative review of the published literature and relevant Ebola outbreak-response guidance. The reported indicators were descriptively summarized, including cases, deaths, alerts, laboratory testing, contact identification and follow-up, IPC activities and population-mobility surveillance. A conceptual Ring 0–Ring 5 framework was developed based on epidemiological proximity and operational connectivity. Ring 0 represents the suspected or confirmed case and immediate care environment; Ring 1 represents direct contacts; Ring 2 represents contacts of contacts and epidemiologically linked exposures; Ring 3 represents high-risk community settings; Ring 4 represents health-system and population-mobility interfaces; and Ring 5 represents regional and cross-border preparedness. The framework incorporates continuous monitoring with escalation, de-escalation or closure according to emerging epidemiological information. Results: By 11 August 2026, the situation report documented 4566 confirmed cases and 2128 confirmed deaths, with 3912 cases (85.7%) reported from Ituri. During the preceding 24 h reporting period, 118 new confirmed cases and 67 deaths were reported. Nationally, 20,728 contacts were identified and 17,085 followed (82.4%). A total of 1542 alerts were received, 1423 verified and 324 classified as suspected cases; 516 specimens were analysed, including 118 positive results. The proposed framework organizes these reported activities sequentially from case detection and immediate IPC (Ring 0), direct-contact investigation and monitoring (Ring 1), linked-exposure surveillance (Ring 2), community-level IPC and engagement (Ring 3), health-system and mobility surveillance (Ring 4), to regional and cross-border preparedness (Ring 5). Continuous epidemiological reassessment provides feedback for intensifying, expanding, de-escalating or closing response activities. Conclusions: The 2026 BDBV outbreak demonstrates the need for coordinated surveillance, case investigation, contact monitoring, IPC, clinical referral, safe and dignified burial, community engagement and health-system preparedness. The proposed ring-oriented surveillance and IPC framework provides a structured and adaptable approach for linking these activities according to epidemiological risk and operational connectivity. However, the present analysis is descriptive and conceptual and does not establish the effectiveness, feasibility or acceptability of the framework. Prospective implementation research is required to evaluate feasibility, acceptability, implementation fidelity and epidemiological effectiveness.

abstract_zh: 背景:刚果民主共和国(DRC)在应对埃博拉疾病暴发方面拥有丰富的经验;然而,本迪布焦病毒(BDBV)的出现带来了明显的操作挑战,因为其流行病学证据基础和可用的医疗对策比扎伊尔埃博拉病毒更为有限。2026 年 暴发 的特点是伊图里省出现大量 传播,据报告其他省份也有活动。运营挑战包括接触者追踪不完整、社区死亡、卫生系统限制、人口流动、不安全以及感染预防和控制 (IPC) 方面的差距。这些挑战凸显了对将案件调查、监测、IPC 和社区参与联系起来的适应性框架的需求。目标:描述 2026 年 BDBV 暴发 的流行病学和操作情况,并根据之前埃博拉 暴发 的证据,制定一个面向环的概念 暴发 和 IPC 框架,用于在伊图里省组织 暴发 应对活动。方法:使用截至 2026 年 8 月 11 日的报告期的 暴发 情况报告进行了二次描述性情况分析,并辅以对已发表文献和相关埃博拉 暴发 应对指南的有针对性的叙述性审查。对报告的指标进行了描述性总结,包括病例、死亡、警报、实验室检测、接触者识别和随访、IPC 活动和人口流动 监测。基于流行病学邻近性和操作连通性,开发了概念性 0 环至 5 环框架。环0代表疑似或确诊病例和即时护理环境;环1代表直接接触;环2代表接触者的接触者和流行病学相关的暴露;环3代表高风险社区环境;环 4 代表卫生系统和人口流动接口;5 环代表区域和跨境准备。该框架包括根据新出现的流行病学信息进行持续监测、升级、降级或关闭。结果:截至 2026 年 8 月 11 日,情况报告记录了 4566 例确诊病例和 2128 例确诊死亡,其中伊图里报告了 3912 例病例(85.7%)。在此前24小时报告期内,报告新增确诊病例118例,死亡67例。在全国范围内,已识别出 20,728 名接触者,并追踪了 17,085 名接触者 (82.4%)。共收到警报1542起,核实1423起,疑似病例324起;对 516 份样本进行了分析,其中 118 份呈阳性结果。拟议的框架按顺序组织这些报告的活动,从病例检测和立即 IPC(环 0)、直接接触调查和监测(环 1)、关联暴露 监测(环 2)、社区级 IPC 和参与(环 3)、卫生系统和流动性 监测(环 4)到区域和跨境准备(环 5)。持续的流行病学重新评估为加强、扩大、降级或结束应对活动提供反馈。结论:2026 年 BDBV 暴发 表明需要协调 监测、病例调查、接触者监测、IPC、临床转诊、安全和有尊严的埋葬、社区参与和卫生系统准备。拟议的面向环的 监测 和 IPC 框架提供了一种结构化且适应性强的方法,用于根据流行病学风险和操作连通性链接这些活动。然而,目前的分析是描述性和概念性的,并没有确定该框架的有效性、可行性或可接受性。需要进行前瞻性实施研究来评估可行性、可接受性、实施保真度和流行病学有效性。

title: A comprehensive Ebola virus–human protein interactome generated by AP-MS and proximity labeling MS
abstract: Ebola virus (EBOV) is a highly pathogenic agent that causes severe hemorrhagic fever in a wide range of mammalian species. Its high mortality rate underscores the urgent need to elucidate the molecular mechanisms governing its life cycle. The development of effective antivirals and vaccines relies on a comprehensive understanding of the molecular basis underlying viral pathogenesis. To this end, a combination of affinity purification (AP) and proximity labeling (PL), coupled with mass spectrometry (MS), was employed to construct a comprehensive protein interactome between EBOV and the human host. This interactome comprises 6,868 interactions involving nine EBOV proteins and 2,643 human interactors. This interactome offers a resource of potential host factors and therapeutic targets, providing a foundation for future mechanistic and therapeutic studies aimed at identifying candidate host factors and pathways.

title_zh: 通过 AP-MS 和邻近标记 MS 生成全面的 埃博拉病毒-人类蛋白质相互作用组
source_body_en: Ebola virus (EBOV) is a highly pathogenic agent that causes severe hemorrhagic fever in a wide range of mammalian species. Its high mortality rate underscores the urgent need to elucidate the molecular mechanisms governing its life cycle. The development of effective antivirals and vaccines relies on a comprehensive understanding of the molecular basis underlying viral pathogenesis. To this end, a combination of affinity purification (AP) and proximity labeling (PL), coupled with mass spectrometry (MS), was employed to construct a comprehensive protein interactome between EBOV and the human host. This interactome comprises 6,868 interactions involving nine EBOV proteins and 2,643 human interactors. This interactome offers a resource of potential host factors and therapeutic targets, providing a foundation for future mechanistic and therapeutic studies aimed at identifying candidate host factors and pathways.

title: Endogenous anti-Ebola virus GP 1,2 antibodies interfere with detection of secreted glycoprotein in the blood of EVD patients
abstract: ABSTRACT Ebola disease (EBOD) is a highly infectious disease with severe hemorrhagic symptoms. It is caused by orthoebolaviruses , which include the Ebola virus ( Orthoebolavirus zairense ) (EBOV) causing Ebola virus disease (EVD), the most lethal EBOD to humans. Through co-transcriptional polymerase stuttering and subsequent proteolytic processing, its GP gene produces multiple protein products, including secreted glycoprotein (sGP) and structural membrane-associated trimeric GP 1,2 . Although sGP is known to circulate in the blood, its physiological significance in disease pathology remains speculative. We quantified sGP using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) in 36 acute human EVD cases from the 10th and 11th EVD outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) using single-time-point biobanked samples. We detected and quantified sGP in four patients with strong GP gene transcription (GP Ct 1,2 IgG. However, sGP was not quantified in patients with lower GP transcription (Ct > 25), regardless of their anti-EBOV GP 1,2 IgG results. While two patients, MAM179 and MAM271, had notably strong GP transcription (Ct 1,2 IgG might have interfered with detection by the assay detection antibody, a human anti-EBOV GP 1,2 /sGP IgG. Furthermore, the addition of sera containing anti-EBOV GP 1,2 IgG reduced the binding between sGP and anti-EBOV GP 1,2 /sGP used as detection antibodies. This suggested that the level of sGP in circulation is strongly linked to the intensity of GP transcription. Additionally, circulating sGP in this context would form complexes with anti-GP 1,2 antibodies, hence hindering additional antibody binding for detection. IMPORTANCE Insight into the mechanism of immune function by the Ebola virus secreted glycoprotein (sGP) in humans is essential for better understanding viral pathogenesis, immune protection, and immune evasion strategies. Research utilizing samples from patients who are infected with or have survived infection with the Ebola virus offers an unparalleled opportunity to determine the immunological significance of sGP. This research evaluates, in acutely infected patients from Ebola virus disease outbreaks, the role of EBOV sGP in modulating antibody responses directed against viral entry glycoprotein. By elucidating how sGP influences antibody-mediated immunity, the study advances our understanding of a conserved immune-evasion mechanism shared across all orthoebolaviruses. These investigations are valuable resources for designing more efficacious vaccines, therapies, and biomarkers for monitoring Ebola virus diseases.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the role of endogenous anti-Ebola virus GP 1,2 antibodies in interfering with the detection of secreted glycoprotein (sGP) in the blood of Ebola virus disease (EVD) patients, as understanding this mechanism is essential for better comprehension of viral pathogenesis and immune evasion strategies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed 36 acute human EVD cases from the 10th and 11th EVD outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo using single-time-point biobanked samples. It focused on patients with varying levels of GP transcription, particularly those with strong GP gene transcription (GP Ct 1,2 IgG) and those with lower GP transcription (Ct > 25).
analysis.methods: sGP was quantified using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) in biobanked samples from EVD patients. The study also tested the effect of sera containing anti-EBOV GP 1,2 IgG on the binding between sGP and detection antibodies.
analysis.main_results: sGP was detected and quantified in four patients with strong GP transcription (GP Ct 1,2 IgG). However, sGP was not quantified in patients with lower GP transcription (Ct > 25), regardless of their anti-EBOV GP 1,2 IgG results. The addition of sera containing anti-EBOV GP 1,2 IgG reduced the binding between sGP and detection antibodies.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that the presence of anti-EBOV GP 1,2 IgG may interfere with the detection of sGP, indicating a potential mechanism by which sGP modulates antibody responses. This provides novel insights into immune evasion strategies of orthoebolaviruses.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results are valuable for improving the design of vaccines, therapies, and biomarkers for monitoring Ebola virus diseases, as they highlight the challenges in detecting sGP and its implications for immune responses.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on single-time-point biobanked samples, which may not capture dynamic changes in sGP levels. The evidence is moderate, as the findings are based on observational data and not experimental manipulation.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the interference of endogenous anti-Ebola virus GP 1,2 antibodies with the detection of secreted glycoprotein (sGP) in the blood of patients with Ebola virus disease (EVD). Using ELISA, sGP was quantified in 36 acute EVD cases from the 10th and 11th outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Results showed that sGP was detectable in patients with strong GP transcription but not in those with lower transcription levels. The study also found that sera containing anti-EBOV GP 1,2 IgG reduced the binding between sGP and detection antibodies, suggesting a potential mechanism for immune evasion. These findings highlight the challenges in detecting sGP and its role in modulating antibody responses, offering insights for vaccine and diagnostic development. However, the study's reliance on single-time-point samples limits its generalizability, and the evidence is considered moderate due to the observational nature of the results.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用单时间点生物库样本分析了刚果民主共和国第 10 次和第 11 次 EVD 暴发 的 36 例急性人类 EVD 病例。它重点关注具有不同 GP 转录水平的患者,特别是 GP 基因转录较强的患者 (GP Ct 1,2 IgG) 和 GP 转录较低的患者 (Ct > 25)。
elements_zh.methods: 使用酶联免疫吸附测定 (ELISA) 对埃博拉病毒病患者生物库样本中的 sGP 进行定量。该研究还测试了含有抗 EBOV GP 1,2 IgG 的血清对 sGP 和检测抗体之间结合的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 在四名具有强 GP 转录(GP Ct 1,2 IgG)的患者中检测到并定量了 sGP。然而,对于 GP 转录较低 (Ct > 25) 的患者,无论其抗 EBOV GP 1,2 IgG 结果如何,sGP 均未进行定量。添加含有抗 EBOV GP 1,2 IgG 的血清可减少 sGP 与检测抗体之间的结合。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,抗埃博拉病毒 GP 1,2 IgG 的存在可能会干扰 sGP 的检测,表明 sGP 调节抗体反应的潜在机制。这为正埃博拉病毒的免疫逃避策略提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果对于改进 疫苗 的设计、用于监测 埃博拉病毒病 的疗法和生物标志物非常有价值,因为它们强调了检测 sGP 的挑战及其对 免疫应答 的影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其依赖于单时间点生物样本库样本而受到限制,该样本可能无法捕获 sGP 水平的动态变化。证据是中等的,因为这些发现是基于观察数据而不是实验操作。

analysis_en.methods: sGP was quantified using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) in biobanked samples from EVD patients. The study also tested the effect of sera containing anti-EBOV GP 1,2 IgG on the binding between sGP and detection antibodies.
analysis_en.main_results: sGP was detected and quantified in four patients with strong GP transcription (GP Ct 1,2 IgG). title_zh: 内源性抗 埃博拉病毒 GP 1,2 抗体干扰 EVD 患者血液中分泌糖蛋白的检测
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Ebola disease (EBOD) is a highly infectious disease with severe hemorrhagic symptoms. It is caused by orthoebolaviruses , which include the Ebola virus ( Orthoebolavirus zairense ) (EBOV) causing Ebola virus disease (EVD), the most lethal EBOD to humans. Through co-transcriptional polymerase stuttering and subsequent proteolytic processing, its GP gene produces multiple protein products, including secreted glycoprotein (sGP) and structural membrane-associated trimeric GP 1,2 . Although sGP is known to circulate in the blood, its physiological significance in disease pathology remains speculative. We quantified sGP using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) in 36 acute human EVD cases from the 10th and 11th EVD outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) using single-time-point biobanked samples. We detected and quantified sGP in four patients with strong GP gene transcription (GP Ct 1,2 IgG. However, sGP was not quantified in patients with lower GP transcription (Ct > 25), regardless of their anti-EBOV GP 1,2 IgG results. While two patients, MAM179 and MAM271, had notably strong GP transcription (Ct 1,2 IgG might have interfered with detection by the assay detection antibody, a human anti-EBOV GP 1,2 /sGP IgG. Furthermore, the addition of sera containing anti-EBOV GP 1,2 IgG reduced the binding between sGP and anti-EBOV GP 1,2 /sGP used as detection antibodies. This suggested that the level of sGP in circulation is strongly linked to the intensity of GP transcription. Additionally, circulating sGP in this context would form complexes with anti-GP 1,2 antibodies, hence hindering additional antibody binding for detection. IMPORTANCE Insight into the mechanism of immune function by the Ebola virus secreted glycoprotein (sGP) in humans is essential for better understanding viral pathogenesis, immune protection, and immune evasion strategies. Research utilizing samples from patients who are infected with or have survived infection with the Ebola virus offers an unparalleled opportunity to determine the immunological significance of sGP. This research evaluates, in acutely infected patients from Ebola virus disease outbreaks, the role of EBOV sGP in modulating antibody responses directed against viral entry glycoprotein. By elucidating how sGP influences antibody-mediated immunity, the study advances our understanding of a conserved immune-evasion mechanism shared across all orthoebolaviruses. These investigations are valuable resources for designing more efficacious vaccines, therapies, and biomarkers for monitoring Ebola virus diseases.

title: What Ebola rumors are about: protocol for an integrative review of rumor accounts and response documents in Ebola disease outbreaks, 1995–2026
abstract: This project holds the protocol, data, code and supporting materials for a critical integrative review titled “What Ebola rumors are about: an integrative review of rumor accounts and response documents in Ebola disease outbreaks, 1995–2026.” Purpose. Ebola response guidance often treats a rumor as false information to be corrected with a message. Many claims recorded during outbreaks, however, concern the response itself. Examples are treatment centers, burial teams, blood samples, vaccines and the use of response funds. A message alone cannot answer a claim about what a team did. No earlier review had counted what recorded Ebola rumors were about across outbreaks. None had compared that record with what response guidance tells responders to do. The review addresses five questions: what sources called the claims they recorded what types of rumor recurred what events and conditions sources connected to each type what harm followed each type how responses tried to counter rumors, and what limited them Methods. The review combines a purposive search of reference lists, repositories and the web with a reproducible search of six bibliographic databases. It covers outbreaks of Ebola, Sudan and Bundibugyo virus disease from 1995 to 2026. Two investigators independently screened every record and extracted and coded every rumor account. They also appraised every source with tools matched to its design. Each account was classified by the object of the claim: the disease, the conduct of the response, or the interests behind the outbreak or the response. Guidance documents were analyzed for how they define rumor and where they send it for handling. The review delivers: a typology of Ebola rumor drawn from 27 outbreak settings an account of what gave rise to each type of rumor and what followed it a comparison of the recorded claims with response guidance a six-step procedure for sending each type of claim to the part of the response that can investigate and answer it The findings are intended for response teams, rumor trackers, national public health agencies and the authors of response guidance. They are especially relevant to the 2026 Bundibugyo virus disease epidemic. The project contains the protocol, codebook and decision rules, and the complete dataset, which holds every search record, screening decision, account, code and appraisal judgment. It also contains the Python code that reproduces the main counts and agreement statistics from the dataset. Investigators: Eric Nzirakaindi Ikoona, Lucy Namulemo, Ronald Kaluya, Rebecca Sakwa and Foday Sahr.

title_zh: 埃博拉谣言是关于什么的:埃博拉疾病谣言和应对文件综合审查协议 暴发,1995-2026
source_body_en: This project holds the protocol, data, code and supporting materials for a critical integrative review titled “What Ebola rumors are about: an integrative review of rumor accounts and response documents in Ebola disease outbreaks, 1995–2026.” Purpose. Ebola response guidance often treats a rumor as false information to be corrected with a message. Many claims recorded during outbreaks, however, concern the response itself. Examples are treatment centers, burial teams, blood samples, vaccines and the use of response funds. A message alone cannot answer a claim about what a team did. No earlier review had counted what recorded Ebola rumors were about across outbreaks. None had compared that record with what response guidance tells responders to do. The review addresses five questions: what sources called the claims they recorded what types of rumor recurred what events and conditions sources connected to each type what harm followed each type how responses tried to counter rumors, and what limited them Methods. The review combines a purposive search of reference lists, repositories and the web with a reproducible search of six bibliographic databases. It covers outbreaks of Ebola, Sudan and Bundibugyo virus disease from 1995 to 2026. Two investigators independently screened every record and extracted and coded every rumor account. They also appraised every source with tools matched to its design. Each account was classified by the object of the claim: the disease, the conduct of the response, or the interests behind the outbreak or the response. Guidance documents were analyzed for how they define rumor and where they send it for handling. The review delivers: a typology of Ebola rumor drawn from 27 outbreak settings an account of what gave rise to each type of rumor and what followed it a comparison of the recorded claims with response guidance a six-step procedure for sending each type of claim to the part of the response that can investigate and answer it The findings are intended for response teams, rumor trackers, national public health agencies and the authors of response guidance. They are especially relevant to the 2026 Bundibugyo virus disease epidemic. The project contains the protocol, codebook and decision rules, and the complete dataset, which holds every search record, screening decision, account, code and appraisal judgment. It also contains the Python code that reproduces the main counts and agreement statistics from the dataset. Investigators: Eric Nzirakaindi Ikoona, Lucy Namulemo, Ronald Kaluya, Rebecca Sakwa and Foday Sahr.
abstract_zh: 该项目拥有用于关键综合审查的协议、数据、代码和支持材料,标题为“埃博拉谣言是关于什么的:对埃博拉疾病 暴发,1995-2026 年谣言描述和应对文件的综合审查”。目的。埃博拉应对指南通常将谣言视为需要通过消息纠正的虚假信息。然而,暴发 期间记录的许多声明都与响应本身有关。例如 治疗 中心、埋葬团队、血液样本、疫苗 以及应对资金的使用。仅一条消息无法回答有关团队所做工作的声明。之前的评论没有统计过 暴发 上记录的埃博拉谣言的内容。没有人将该记录与响应指南告诉响应者要做的事情进行比较。该评论解决了五个问题:哪些消息来源称其记录了哪些类型的谣言重复出现,与每种类型相关的事件和条件来源,每种类型会带来哪些危害,如何应对谣言,以及哪些限制了谣言的方法。该审查结合了对参考文献列表、存储库和网络的有目的地搜索以及对六个书目数据库的可重复搜索。它涵盖了1995年至2026年埃博拉、苏丹和本迪布焦病毒病的暴发。两名调查员独立筛选了每一条记录,并对每条谣言进行了提取和编码。他们还使用与其设计相匹配的工具评估每个来源。每个帐户均按索赔对象进行分类:疾病、响应行为或 暴发 或响应背后的利益。对指导文件进行了分析,了解它们如何定义谣言以及将谣言发送到何处进行处理。该评论提供了: 从 27 个 暴发 设置中提取的埃博拉谣言的类型 对每种谣言的产生原因及其后续情况进行说明 将记录的声明与响应指南进行比较 将每种类型的声明发送到可以调查和回答的响应部分的六步程序 这些调查结果适用于响应团队、谣言追踪者、国家公共卫生机构和响应指南的作者。它们与 2026 年本迪布焦病毒病的流行尤其相关。该项目包含协议、密码本和决策规则,以及完整的数据集,其中包含每条搜索记录、筛选决策、账户、代码和评估判断。它还包含从数据集中重现主要计数和一致性统计数据的 Python 代码。调查员:埃里克·恩齐拉坎迪·伊库纳、露西·纳穆莱莫、罗纳德·卡卢亚、丽贝卡·萨夸和福迪·萨尔。

title: Ancestral state reconstruction with discrete characters using deep learning.
abstract: Ancestral state reconstruction is a classical problem of broad relevance in phylogenetics. Likelihood-based methods for reconstructing ancestral states under discrete character models, such as Markov models and state-dependent speciation-extinction models, have proven extremely useful, but only work so long as the assumed model yields a tractable likelihood function. Unfortunately, extending a simple but tractable phylogenetic model to possess new, but biologically realistic, properties often results in an intractable likelihood, preventing its use in standard modeling tasks, including ancestral state reconstruction. The rapid advancement of deep learning offers a potential alternative to likelihood-based inference of ancestral states, particularly for models with intractable likelihoods. In this study, we modify the phylogenetic deep learning software phyddle to conduct ancestral state reconstruction. We evaluate phyddle's performance under various methodological and modeling conditions, while comparing to Bayesian inference when possible. For simple Markov models and small trees, its performance resembles the performance of Bayesian inference, but worsens as tree size increases. While phyddle still performs adequately for more complex models, such as state-dependent speciation-extinction models, the estimates differ more from Bayesian inference in comparison with simpler models. Lastly, we use phyddle to infer ancestral states for two empirical datasets, one of the ancestral ranges of a subclade of the genus Liolaemus and ancestral locations for sequences from the 2014 Sierra Leone Ebola virus disease outbreak.

title: Computational Design and Biophysical Evaluation of VC032: A Multi-Epitope Vaccine Candidate Targeting Four Human-Pathogenic Orthoebolaviruses
abstract: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD), caused by four human-pathogenic Orthoebolavirus species (Bundibugyo, Sudan, Taï Forest, and Zaire ebolaviruses), presents severe mortality (40%–90%). Licensed vaccines confer protection exclusively against Zaire ebolavirus, leaving persistent vulnerabilities against heterologous species due to 30%–40% envelope glycoprotein divergence. To address this, we executed proteome-wide immunoinformatics screening across 20,723 viral sequences encompassing seven structural and non-structural proteins. Multi-tier filtering for MHC restriction, conservancy, non-allergenicity, and human proteome non-homology identified 24 conserved epitopes across five viral targets (GP, VP35, VP24, L-polymerase, NP). From a combinatorial screen of 48 unique vaccine candidates, construct VC032 was prioritized, integrating a human β-defensin-3 adjuvant via specialized linkers. VC032 achieved ≥99.8% HLA coverage across African outbreak epicenters and globally. Tertiary structure prediction and refinement confirmed favorable stereochemical quality (92.5% Ramachandran favored). analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the limitations of current vaccines in protecting against multiple human-pathogenic orthoebolaviruses, specifically targeting four species: Bundibugyo, Sudan, Taï Forest, and Zaire ebolaviruses. These viruses cause severe mortality, with Ebola Virus Disease presenting a significant public health concern.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research involved proteome-wide immunoinformatics screening across 20,723 viral sequences, focusing on seven structural and non-structural proteins, to identify conserved epitopes for vaccine development.
analysis.methods: Proteome-wide immunoinformatics screening was conducted across 20,723 viral sequences, followed by multi-tier filtering for MHC restriction, conservancy, non-allergenicity, and human proteome non-homology, to identify 24 conserved epitopes across five viral targets (GP, VP35, VP24, L-polymerase, NP).
analysis.main_results: A combinatorial screen of 48 unique vaccine candidates identified construct VC032, which achieved ≥99.8% HLA coverage across African outbreak epicenters and globally. VC032 demonstrated stable interfacial engagement and robust binding free energies with the human TLR1/TLR2 receptor complex.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: VC032 was prioritized for its broad HLA coverage and favorable binding properties, representing a novel multi-epitope vaccine candidate against multiple orthoebolaviruses.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: VC032's broad HLA coverage and favorable binding properties suggest it could serve as a blueprint for a broad-spectrum pan-orthoebolavirus vaccine, potentially reducing the risk of Ebola Virus Disease outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the need for further experimental validation and the reliance on in silico methods, which may not fully capture the complexities of in vivo immune responses.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to develop a multi-epitope vaccine against four human-pathogenic orthoebolaviruses. Using proteome-wide immunoinformatics screening, a candidate construct (VC032) was identified, achieving broad HLA coverage and favorable binding properties. Further experimental validation is required to confirm its efficacy.

elements_zh.methods: 对 20,723 个病毒序列进行了全蛋白质组免疫信息学筛选,然后针对 MHC 限制性、保守性、非过敏性和人类蛋白质组非同源性进行多层过滤,以识别 5 个病毒靶点(GP、VP35、VP24、L-聚合酶、NP)的 24 个保守表位。
elements_zh.main_results: 对 48 个独特的 疫苗 候选物进行组合筛选,确定了构建体 VC032,该构建体在非洲 暴发 震中和全球范围内实现了 ≥99.8% 的 HLA 覆盖率。VC032 与人类 TLR1/TLR2 受体复合物表现出稳定的界面接合和强大的结合自由能。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: VC032 因其广泛的 HLA 覆盖范围和良好的结合特性而被优先考虑,代表了一种针对多种正埃博拉病毒的新型多表位 疫苗 候选药物。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: VC032 广泛的 HLA 覆盖范围和良好的结合特性表明它可以作为广谱泛正埃博拉病毒 疫苗 的蓝图,可能降低 埃博拉病毒病 暴发 的风险。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the limitations of current vaccines in protecting against multiple human-pathogenic orthoebolaviruses, specifically targeting four species: Bundibugyo, Sudan, Taï Forest, and Zaire ebolaviruses. These viruses cause severe mortality, with Ebola Virus Disease presenting a significant public health concern.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The research involved proteome-wide immunoinformatics screening across 20,723 viral sequences, focusing on seven structural and non-structural proteins, to identify conserved epitopes for vaccine development.
analysis_en.methods: Proteome-wide immunoinformatics screening was conducted across 20,723 viral sequences, followed by multi-tier filtering for MHC restriction, conservancy, non-allergenicity, and human proteome non-homology, to identify 24 conserved epitopes across five viral targets (GP, VP35, VP24, L-polymerase, NP).
analysis_en.main_results: A combinatorial screen of 48 unique vaccine candidates identified construct VC032, which achieved ≥99.8% HLA coverage across African outbreak epicenters and globally. analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: VC032 was prioritized for its broad HLA coverage and favorable binding properties, representing a novel multi-epitope vaccine candidate against multiple orthoebolaviruses.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: VC032's broad HLA coverage and favorable binding properties suggest it could serve as a blueprint for a broad-spectrum pan-orthoebolavirus vaccine, potentially reducing the risk of Ebola Virus Disease outbreaks.

title_zh: VC032 的计算设计和生物物理评估:针对四种人类致病性正博拉病毒的多表位 疫苗 候选药物
source_body_en: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD), caused by four human-pathogenic Orthoebolavirus species (Bundibugyo, Sudan, Taï Forest, and Zaire ebolaviruses), presents severe mortality (40%–90%). Licensed vaccines confer protection exclusively against Zaire ebolavirus, leaving persistent vulnerabilities against heterologous species due to 30%–40% envelope glycoprotein divergence. To address this, we executed proteome-wide immunoinformatics screening across 20,723 viral sequences encompassing seven structural and non-structural proteins. Multi-tier filtering for MHC restriction, conservancy, non-allergenicity, and human proteome non-homology identified 24 conserved epitopes across five viral targets (GP, VP35, VP24, L-polymerase, NP). From a combinatorial screen of 48 unique vaccine candidates, construct VC032 was prioritized, integrating a human β-defensin-3 adjuvant via specialized linkers. VC032 achieved ≥99.8% HLA coverage across African outbreak epicenters and globally. Tertiary structure prediction and refinement confirmed favorable stereochemical quality (92.5% Ramachandran favored). Molecular docking and 100-ns all-atom molecular dynamics with the human TLR1/TLR2 receptor complex demonstrated stable interfacial engagement (mean 977 contacts, 29 hydrogen bonds) and robust binding free energies (MM-GBSA: −216.84 ± 15.27 kcal/mol). Immune simulations in V032 predicted coordinated B-cell and Th1-skewed memory responses. In silico codon optimization and virtual cloning into pET-28a(+) established translational feasibility for bacterial expression, delivering a broad-spectrum pan-orthoebolavirus vaccine blueprint. Further experimental validation is required.

title: Lassa fever outbreak across two tertiary hospitals in Rivers State, Nigeria: clinical spectrum, healthcare-associated infection, contact investigation and public health response
abstract: Abstract Background Lassa fever (LF) remains a major public health threat in Nigeria, with outcomes influenced by timely diagnosis and treatment and by potential healthcare-associated transmission. We characterised confirmed LF cases and conducted contact investigations at two tertiary hospitals in Rivers State, Nigeria, during the 2024 outbreak. Methods We conducted a descriptive two-centre case series of confirmed LF cases identified at the University of Port Harcourt Teaching Hospital (UPTH) and Rivers State University Teaching Hospital (RSUTH) from January 23 to August 13, 2024. Cases were confirmed by real-time reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) for Lassa virus. Clinical, epidemiological, laboratory, treatment, and outcome data were obtained from hospital and public health records. Contact investigations included risk stratification, 21-day active surveillance, clinical assessment and RT-PCR testing of symptomatic contacts, and ribavirin post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) for eligible high-risk contacts. Analysis was descriptive. Results Seven laboratory-confirmed cases were identified: five community-associated and two healthcare-associated infections among high-risk healthcare-worker contacts of the UPTH index case. Patients were aged 21–61 years, and four were male. Five patients had gastrointestinal and haemorrhagic manifestations (71.43%), while three had AKI and neurological manifestations (42.86%). Five patients survived, and two died, giving a case fatality proportion of 28.57%. Both deaths occurred in community-associated index cases before therapeutic ribavirin could be administered. Contact surveillance detected the two healthcare-associated infections, which had mild clinical courses. At UPTH, 106 primary contacts were identified; 42 were high-risk, of whom 31 developed acute febrile illness, and two were confirmed with secondary LF. All 42 high-risk contacts received ribavirin PEP. At RSUTH, eight high-risk contacts were monitored; one received PEP, and none developed secondary infection. One survivor with severe renal disease required six haemodialysis sessions and was discharged after 18 days. Conclusions The LF outbreak demonstrated substantial clinical heterogeneity, ranging from mild healthcare-associated infection to severe multisystem disease and death. Contact investigation and prospective surveillance enabled detection of healthcare-associated secondary infections and facilitated targeted PEP. Strengthening early recognition, healthcare-worker protection, laboratory confirmation, contact surveillance, and timely treatment should remain priorities for LF preparedness and outbreak response in Nigeria.

title: Nanosensors for Homeland Security
abstract: Dangers to homeland security are posed by explosives and biothreat agents. Explosives considered are TNT, tetryl, picric acid, and RDX. Among the biothreat agents, anthrax spores, plague, Francisella tularensis and Brucella bacterium, smallpox and Ebola viruses, and ricin, SEB toxin, and aflatoxin require speedy, accurate detection. Eight types of nanosensors for TNT, two types for TNT/Tetryl, five types for picric acid, and four for RDX/other explosives are described. Two types of nanosensors for anthrax spores, one for plague bacterium, two types for Francisella tularensis bacterium, three types for Brucella, one type for Variola virus, three types for Ebola virus; and three types each for ricin, SEB, and aflatoxin are pondered over. These nanosensors include a miscellany of techniques, including colorimetric devices, luminescence in various forms (photoluminescence/fluorescence/electroluminescence), fluorescence intensity quenching via Meisenheimer complex formation, surface plasmon resonance, surface-enhanced Raman scattering, Raman spectroscopy, and electrochemical phenomena.

title_zh: 用于国土安全的纳米传感器
source_body_en: Dangers to homeland security are posed by explosives and biothreat agents. Explosives considered are TNT, tetryl, picric acid, and RDX. Among the biothreat agents, anthrax spores, plague, Francisella tularensis and Brucella bacterium, smallpox and Ebola viruses, and ricin, SEB toxin, and aflatoxin require speedy, accurate detection. Eight types of nanosensors for TNT, two types for TNT/Tetryl, five types for picric acid, and four for RDX/other explosives are described. Two types of nanosensors for anthrax spores, one for plague bacterium, two types for Francisella tularensis bacterium, three types for Brucella, one type for Variola virus, three types for Ebola virus; and three types each for ricin, SEB, and aflatoxin are pondered over. These nanosensors include a miscellany of techniques, including colorimetric devices, luminescence in various forms (photoluminescence/fluorescence/electroluminescence), fluorescence intensity quenching via Meisenheimer complex formation, surface plasmon resonance, surface-enhanced Raman scattering, Raman spectroscopy, and electrochemical phenomena.
abstract_zh: 爆炸物和生物威胁剂对国土安全构成威胁。考虑的炸药有 TNT、四硝基苯、苦味酸和黑索金。在生物威胁因子中,炭疽孢子、鼠疫、土拉弗朗西斯菌和布鲁氏菌、天花和 埃博拉病毒、蓖麻毒素、SEB 毒素和黄曲霉毒素需要快速、准确的检测。描述了八种 TNT 纳米传感器、两种 TNT/Tetryl、五种苦味酸纳米传感器和四种 RDX/其他炸药纳米传感器。两种炭疽芽孢纳米传感器,一种用于鼠疫细菌,两种用于土拉弗朗西斯菌,三种用于布鲁氏菌,一种用于天花病毒,三种用于埃博拉病毒;并考虑了蓖麻毒素、SEB 和黄曲霉毒素各三种类型。这些纳米传感器包括多种技术,包括比色装置、各种形式的发光(光致发光/荧光/电致发光)、通过迈森海默复合物形成的荧光强度猝灭、表面等离子体共振、表面增强拉曼散射、拉曼光谱和电化学现象。
